name: Kaymard Copperpinch
summary: In Orgrimmar, Kaymard Copperpinch sells Smokywood Pastures goods for Winter Veil. He trades in the Valley of Strength, where travelers can find festive wares and help with holiday troubles.

sections.title: A Goblin's Winter Veil
sections.body: Kaymard Copperpinch brings Smokywood Pastures to the Valley of Strength each Feast of Winter Veil. Great-father Winter receives visitors nearby as Kaymard sells fine treats, festive wrapping paper, and other holiday goods. To a goblin, no grand festival is complete without a lively exchange of coin.

sections.title: Holiday Complications
sections.body: Kaymard also handles troubles that threaten Smokywood Pastures during the festival. Holiday confections go missing, and Metzen the Reindeer disappears. Kaymard calls on Horde adventurers to solve these problems and keep Winter Veil running smoothly.

faq.answer: Kaymard Copperpinch is a goblin merchant with Smokywood Pastures. During the Feast of Winter Veil, he trades in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, selling fine seasonal goods and asking passersby to help with holiday troubles.

Smokywood Pastures is a vendor consortium that supplies food, treats, and seasonal goods for the Feast of Winter Veil across Azeroth. It supplies both the Horde and the Alliance, and turns a tidy profit.

faq.q: Where can I find Kaymard Copperpinch?
faq.answer: Kaymard Copperpinch stands in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, near the central festival display where Great-father Winter sits during the Feast of Winter Veil.

faq.q: Why does he ask adventurers for help during the holidays?
faq.answer: Smokywood Pastures faces troubles during Winter Veil, including stolen holiday sweets and the kidnapping of its prized reindeer, Metzen. Kaymard hires willing adventurers to recover the stolen goods and Metzen, and protect the season's profits.

angles.text: For the Horde, Kaymard brings Winter Veil's trade to Orgrimmar, where goblin enterprise joins the traditional winter celebrations.
As a cook, you can find seasonal recipes and specialty ingredients for traditional holiday treats through Kaymard and his Smokywood Pastures associates.
